tables.name: Style Amplification
tables.description: How upgrading to a stronghold amplifies the castle's style. Apply the listed changes to your keep and castle; Bristling Defenses and Magical Forms roll their extra defenses.

results.name: Additional Curtain Wall
results.description: The entire fortification is surrounded by an additional wall. Castle: thickness and height of this new curtain wall are equal to (or, if you prefer, less than) that of your other curtain walls.

results.name: Low Hulk
results.description: The fortress favors reinforcement over height, creating a low-slung, brutish construction. Keep: -1 floor (min. 1 above-ground floor, 1 cellar); if box-shaped, increase floor area by 2x2 squares; if round, by 2 squares in diameter; increase exterior wall thickness by 5 feet. Castle: reduce curtain wall height and tower height by 10 feet (to a minimum of 10 feet); increase curtain wall thickness by 5 feet; additional curtain wall defenses: Batters.

results.name: Great Drums
results.description: The keep, towers, and curtain walls are all built with curving surfaces to help deflect both weaponry and weather. (Increase all thickness rolls by one step.) Keep: if box-shaped, shape is now round (use diameter for floor area); increase exterior wall thickness by 5 feet. Castle: if box-shaped, all curtain wall towers are now round (use diameter for floor area); increase curtain wall thickness by 5 feet.

results.name: Tiered
results.description: A heavy wall surrounds the perimeter, at ground level, and the fortress rises in stepped elevation to a high peak. Fortifications and internal structures line the steps. Keep: +1 floor. Castle: increase curtain wall thickness of outermost curtain wall by 5 feet; increase curtain wall height and tower height by 5 feet.

results.name: Massive Curtain Walls
results.description: The fortress’ curtain walls, and keep exterior walls, are huge. Castle: increase curtain wall thickness by 10 feet; increase curtain wall height and tower height by 10 feet.

results.name: Bristling Defenses
results.description: There are more defenses than there otherwise might be. Castle: roll 1 additional time on the curtain wall defenses table.

results.name: Fortified Entries
results.description: Special focus has been placed on protecting what would be the weakest points: the entrances. Keep: entry has a reinforced heavy door with a portcullis and drawbridge. Castle: the approach goes over a drawbridge, through a gatehouse, through a walled approach and across another drawbridge, before passing through the outermost wall; your gatehouses are Grand Gatehouses. (These are optional maximums - GMs may choose to select lesser options.)

results.name: Great Moat
results.description: The exterior perimeter of the stronghold is surrounded by a massive moat. Castle: choose a moat type (dry, dry [trapped], filled or filled [trapped]); your moat is 35 feet across and 40 feet deep.

results.name: Mighty Keep
results.description: The stronghold’s keep is especially robust. Keep: if box-shaped, increase floor area by 2x2 squares; if round, by 2 squares in diameter; increase exterior wall thickness by 5 feet; +1 floor.

results.name: Watchful
results.description: Vigilance is of paramount importance. Castle: +2 towers; if box-shaped, increase floor area for all towers by 2x2 squares; if round, by 2 squares in diameter; +10 feet to tower height.

results.name: Under Cover
results.description: The wall-walks are covered with permanent fortifications, allowing for safer patrols and easier defense. Castle: increase curtain wall thickness by 5 feet; add ‘Machicolations’ to curtain wall defenses.

results.name: Magical Forms
results.description: Magical runes, symbols, or patterns were planned and worked into the construction of the stronghold itself. Castle: roll once on the magical defenses table.
